First Friday Rides

Sioux Falls, SD · Mountain bike

First Friday Rides is a mountain bike group ride in Sioux Falls, SD. It rolls first Friday of the month at 5:30 pm from Sioux Falls Bicycle Company.

Next ride Fri, Oct 2, 5:30 PM CDT

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @sfbicyclecompany the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the First Friday Rides group ride

A monthly mountain bike ride from Sioux Falls Bicycle Company. It usually starts at the shop. The group rides an hour or two around different Sioux Falls riding spots.
